# UJIMA OS

> A sovereign agentic operating system for nonprofits, community organizations, volunteer teams, NGOs and other mission-driven organizations.

## Key pages
- / — public UJIMA site
- /login — member sign in
- /workspaces — tenant/client workspace selection
- /ops — authenticated operations workspace

## Product boundary
UJIMA is the reusable product. ASC3ND is Client 01 and remains isolated as a tenant.

## Operating model
Goal → ICM context → workflow → bounded capability → approval when needed → verification → evidence → memory.

## Safety
Consequential external actions remain human-controlled. Browser/computer-use agents are bounded operators and are not the canonical orchestrator.
